correctness.rationale: Scale by t0=x0²/(4D): the reflection principle and independence give survival erf(t^(−1/2))^N. Restarting the entire ensemble at the first exponential clock gives h(z+ρ)/(1−ρh(z+ρ)). Its value and negative z derivative at zero give mean and half the raw second moment. Differentiating in ρ using h(0)=m0, h′(0)=−m1, h″(0)=m2 (finite since N>6) gives the asserted mean and variance slopes and C′=2(2m1²−m0m2)/m0³. Right differentiability and a nonzero slope suffice for the local strict comparison, and positive rescalings preserve signs. Independently certified signs on 4096 rational cells using degree 64/65 Taylor bounds, rational Machin normalization, outward-grid bounds on erf(u)/u, and exact tail and interval propagation. Outward slope-box numerators at scale 10^6, in order mean, variance, 2m1²−m0m2: 7 ([81616,89115], [−2946308,−2896667], [−1432566,−1413229]); 8 ([128610,135460], [−558489,−520491], [−289305,−279046]); 9 ([139906,146323], [−107318,−75947], [−82414,−75579]); 10 ([139531,145643], [18824,45917], [−23427,−18360]).
residual_risks: Only four team sizes and sufficiently small positive common reset rates checked. The frozen script was inspected, not executed. VERIFICATION.md calls the quotient complementary-error-function in one sentence; the theorem and code correctly use erf, not erfc.
